items.title: Hermes Agent
items.description: Hermes Agent is an open-source, self-improving AI agent by Nous Research that runs persistently with memory across sessions, and builds reusable skills from experience. It comes with 40+ built-in tools, including web search, browser automation, and vision, plus scheduled automations and subagents.
items.description_zh: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 开发的一款开源、自我改进的 AI 智能体，它可以跨会话持续运行内存，并根据经验构建可重用的技能。它配备了 40 多个内置工具，包括网络搜索、浏览器自动化和视觉，以及计划的自动化和子智能体。
